newsitem.title: GREECE: Proodeftiki OK'd for 3-for-10 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Proodeftiki OK'd for 3-for-10 bonus issue.

text.p: Greek construction firm Proodeftiki got shareholder approval for a three-for-10 bonus issue at Friday's annual general meeting.
Proodeftiki said in a statement will capitalise reserves totalling 1.679 billion drachmas and will issue 2,326,500 new common registered shares, raising share par value by 131 drachmas to 285.
Management told shareholders that first-half pretax profit rose 38 percent year-on-year to 600 million drachmas on turnover growth of 51 percent to 4.4 billion.
Proodeftiki will pay a dividend per share of 70 drachmas for fiscal 1996 versus 50 a year earlier.
In 1996 its pretax earnings rose 15.9 percent to 1.512 billion drachmas while turnover grew 22.5 percent to 7.912 billion.
Proodeftiki's shares will trade ex-bonus and ex-dividend on June 30. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
